title: Evaluation of Feature Attribution Methods in Interpretable Machine Learning (BASc Honours thesis, Simon Fraser University, Summer 2022)
people: The academic supervisor, Dr. Ivan V. Bajić, and the committee members, Dr. Mirza Faisal Beg and Dr. Parvaneh Saeedi, are thanked by name in the author's acknowledgements (page iv); their signatures were only on the removed approval page
rights: Copyright Paige Rattenberry 2022 (title page): the author's own work.
permission: Recorded in the private source inventory: publishable as Paige's own work, on the condition (decided 2026-09-12) that a copy with page 2, the signed approval page, removed is what ships. Consent for the people thanked by name in the acknowledgements recorded in the inventory, 2026-09-15.
transformations: Original page 2 (the signed approval page) removed with pdf-lib by scripts/derive-thesis-pdf.mjs on 2026-09-13; 49 pages became 48 and page 2 of the copy is the abstract. Document metadata kept the title and author; the producer field now names pdf-lib.

Re-derived on 2026-09-14 after review found that the first copy still carried the removed page's objects (its form XObject, the four scanned images inside it and the approval file's info dict), unlinked from the page tree but readable with a PDF object tool. The script now also drops the named destination that pointed at page 2 and deletes every object not reachable from the trailer (10 objects: the page, its content stream, the form XObject, its four images and info dict, the named destination, and a stray stream-length number), and renumbers the page labels so the viewer shows the printed numbers (i, iii to viii, then 1). The modification date is fixed so the derivation is reproducible. No kept page, image or text was changed; tests/unit/documents.test.ts checks for orphaned objects, the page-object count and the labels.

Checked after derivation: pdftotext over the whole copy finds no placeholder, no approval or signature text and no phone number (the generic DESIGN §3.4 pattern matches only IoU table rows and DOI strings); the text-only check cannot inspect the JPEG 2000 figure images, which are the author's own experiment output and reference figures reproduced from cited papers.

title: Interpretability and Explainability in Generative Artificial Intelligence: Literature Review (Paige Rattenberry, 21 April 2024)
rights: Paige Rattenberry's own single-author literature review (title page, 21 April 2024). Figures inside it are reproduced from the cited papers (e.g. the DARPA XAI chart on page 2), so the PDF ships whole and no figure is ever lifted out as a site image.
permission: Recorded in the private source inventory: publishable as Paige's own work, no other people in it. Paige decided on 2026-09-15 that it ships as a copy, not a derivative (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN §4 Session 6 amendment).
transformations: Copied whole by scripts/derive-literature-review-pdf.mjs (pdf-lib) on 2026-09-16: all 10 pages, text and images unchanged. The Word export carried no /Title, which every shipped document needs, so the title page's title was written into the document info; the author field (Paige Rattenberry) and the Word creator/producer fields are kept; the modification date is fixed so the derivation is reproducible (two runs give identical bytes).
One unreachable object (an empty /Names dictionary Word's export left behind) is deleted so tests/unit/documents.test.ts finds nothing outside the page tree; page sizes and labels match the original.

Checked before shipping: pdftotext and pdf-parse over all 10 pages find no placeholder, no email or phone number and no name other than the author's (the running header repeats it). The DESIGN §3.4 phone pattern matches only DOI strings and a page range in the references on pages 9 and 10, each given a page-specific exception in tests/unit/documents.test.ts.
